text:
At four-forty-one, the session ends.

You don't know this because anyone tells you. You know it because Ines's indicator in the messaging system changes from *in a meeting* to nothing, and a minute later Veth's does the same.

The shape of what happened is about to resolve. What you built — who knew what, who was in that room in what form, how much documentation the Archivist's testimony added to what you already had — is determining the outcome right now, in the six minutes before anyone sends a message.
